title: Bears, Trains, & Icebergs Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
-You won’t see more in a day on the AK Railroad than on this trip. Many of our guests tell us it is their best day in Alaska.
-Ride the Glacier Discovery train.
-Visit the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center, Alaska's premier center for orphaned and injured wild animals.
-Float by icebergs on Spencer Glacier Lake with a 7-mile river float down the Placer River Valley on the most scenic river trip in Alaska.
